text: dsh-loopback-bridge 是面向 DSH Web 的插件，通过 WebServer 注入浏览器脚本，并在连接模块创建时将连接标记为本机，使从局域网地址或域名打开的设置页可以使用。它提供桥接脚本路由、页面首部注入和连接标记，也包含客户端生命周期中的补充标记。适合通过受信任远程地址管理 DSH Web 设置的使用者；安装后需要配置服务端 trusted-host。

dsh-loopback-bridge lets DSH Web settings work from a LAN address or hostname. It serves and injects a browser bridge that marks the connection as loopback, with a client lifecycle fallback. For remote use, configure the server trusted-host for your address.
想从家里局域网的其他设备修改 DSH Web 模型设置。
通过自己的域名打开 DSH 后，设置页面无法保存该怎么办？
让远程访问的 DSH Web 设置页也能写入配置。
我希望在 NAS 地址访问 DSH 时仍能编辑模型和凭据。
从非 localhost 地址打开时，怎么恢复 DSH 设置页的可写状态？
How can I edit DSH Web model settings from another device on my LAN?
Make the DSH settings page writable when I open it through my hostname.
My remote DSH settings page says settings are unavailable; how can I enable it?
dsh-loopback-bridge 的功能「远程设置页」：把浏览器连接标记为 loopback，使 DSH 设置页在非回环 hostname 下能够使用。页面载入时注入脚本，并在 connection 模块应用后设置标记。
dsh-loopback-bridge 的功能「桥接脚本注入」：向 WebServer 注册 /loopback-bridge.js，并优先插入 HTML head 开头；缺少 tapIndex 时使用 index-inject 事件注入。
dsh-loopback-bridge 的功能「客户端补充标记」：注册客户端 fiber 并依赖 connection 服务，在 apply 时将 connection.isLoopback 设为 true，作为脚本桥接之外的补充路径。
dsh-loopback-bridge 使用前须知：代码会把浏览器连接标记为 loopback，以便启用设置写入；远程入口应由服务端 trusted-host 和访问鉴权限制。
dsh-loopback-bridge README · Introduction：<div align="center">

dsh-loopback-bridge README · dsh-loopback-bridge：用局域网 IP 或公网域名打开 DSH，设置页也能改模型和 API Key 装完重启即可 · 不改官方源码 · 入口必须有鉴权 **[English](README.en.md)** · 中文 --- > [!WARNING] > 这个插件把「仅本机」的设置和凭据写入能力，开放给所有能打开这个 DSH 页面的人。家庭局域网自己看着办；挂公网就必须在前面加 authentik / oauth2-proxy 这类鉴权。接入前先备份，数据丢了概不负责。

dsh-loopback-bridge README · 这是什么：DSH 设置页只认地址栏是不是本机（`127.0.0.1` / `localhost`）。用 `192.168.x.x` 或自己的域名打开时，页面会报 *"settings are unavailable in this browser"*，模型 tab 改不了。

服务端从 0.1.2 起已经认 `--trusted-host`，RPC 本身能通。卡住的是浏览器里那一刀：设置页看见 hostname 不是回环，直接进只读，请求都不发。这个插件在页面加载时把连接标成本机，设置页就会正常工作。

dsh-loopback-bridge README · ✨ 特性：- **远程能改设置** —— 局域网 IP、NAS 域名、公网域名打开，模型和凭据都能写
- **不改官方包** —— DSH 随便升级；官方哪天认 trusted-host 了，卸掉就行
- **装完即生效** —— `dsh plugin add` 之后重启 web，不用手改 nginx
- **0.1.2 友好** —— 不要再把 Host 改写成 `127.0.0.1`，cookie 会对不上然后 401

dsh-loopback-bridge README · 1. 确认服务端已经信任你的访问地址：`dsh web` 启动参数里要带上实际用来打开页面的 Host，例如：

```bash
dsh web --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3080 \
  --trusted-host 192.168.31.229 \
  --trusted-host dsh.example.com
```
section: 1. 确认服务端已经信任你的访问地址

```

dsh-loopback-bridge README · 3. 重启 `dsh web`：Docker 共享 netns 的栈不要只 `restart` 单个容器，整栈重建。装完刷新页面，远程打开设置 → 模型，应该能改了。

dsh-loopback-bridge README · ⚙️ 要求：| 项 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | 按 `0.1.2-rc.1` 验证，`0.1.5+` 必用 1.0.1（旧版会把官方 `__ModuleLoader__` 盖掉，浏览器报 bootstrap facade is missing）。更早版本服务端还要改 Host，不推荐 |
| `--trusted-host` | 必须覆盖你实际访问用的 hostname / IP |
| 反代 | **不要**把特权 API 的 Host 改写成 `127.0.0.1`（0.1.2 的 cookie 绑 Host，改了会 401） |
| 鉴权 | LAN 信任模型可以裸奔；公网必须有反代鉴权 |

dsh-loopback-bridge README · 验证：打开远程地址的设置页，模型 tab 不再报 *unavailable*，能保存 API Key 就算成功。

dsh-loopback-bridge README · 🔒 安全：插件只动客户端。谁能打开 DSH 页面，谁就能改设置、写 `credentials.set`。这在自家反代后面是正确语义，裸奔公网则不是。

dsh-loopback-bridge README · dsh-loopback-bridge：Use DSH settings over a LAN IP or public hostname, not just localhost Install and restart · No official source edits · Put auth in front of the entry **[中文](README.md)** · English --- > [!WARNING] > This plugin opens the “localhost-only” settings and credential-write surface to anyone who can load the DSH page. Fine on a home LAN you already trust; on the public internet, put authentik / oauth2-proxy (or equivalent) in front. Back up first. Data loss is on you.

dsh-loopback-bridge README · What is this：The DSH settings page only treats the UI as writable when the address bar looks local (`127.0.0.1` / `localhost`). Open it via `192.168.x.x` or your own domain and you get *"settings are unavailable in this browser"* — the Models tab will not save.

dsh-loopback-bridge README · What is this：From 0.1.2 the server already honors `--trusted-host`, so the RPCs themselves can succeed. The blocker is the browser: the settings UI sees a non-loopback hostname, drops into read-only, and never sends the request. This plugin marks the connection as loopback at page load so settings work again.

dsh-loopback-bridge README · ✨ Features：- **Remote settings actually write** — LAN IP, NAS name, or public domain: models and API keys save
- **No official package edits** — upgrade DSH as you like; remove this plugin if upstream ever trusts the hostname
- **Works after install** — `dsh plugin add`, restart web, no nginx Host hacks
- **0.1.2-safe** — do **not** rewrite Host to `127.0.0.1`; the auth cookie is bound to the real Host and will 401

dsh-loopback-bridge README · 1. Trust the Host you actually open：`dsh web` must list every hostname / IP you use in the address bar:

```bash
dsh web --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3080 \
  --trusted-host 192.168.31.229 \
  --trusted-host dsh.example.com
```
section: 1. Trust the Host you actually open

dsh-loopback-bridge README · 3. Restart `dsh web`：On Docker stacks that share a netns, recreate the whole stack — do not `restart` a single container. Refresh the page and open Settings → Models from the remote URL.

dsh-loopback-bridge README · ⚙️ Requirements：| Item | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | Verified on `0.1.2-rc.1`. `0.1.5+` needs 1.0.1 (older builds wipe the official `__ModuleLoader__` and the page dies with bootstrap facade is missing). Pre-0.1.2 still needed Host rewrites; skip them |
| `--trusted-host` | Must cover the hostname / IP in the address bar |
| Reverse proxy | **Do not** rewrite privileged API Host to `127.0.0.1` (0.1.2 cookies bind to Host) |
| Auth | LAN trust is fine; public entry needs a reverse-proxy login |

dsh-loopback-bridge README · Verify：Open settings on the remote URL. If the Models tab is no longer *unavailable* and an API key saves, you are done.

text:
dsh-loopback-bridge README · 🔒 Security：The plugin only touches the client. Anyone who can open the DSH page can change settings and call `credentials.set`. That is the right model behind your own reverse proxy, and the wrong one on a naked public port.

If upstream later issues `isLoopback` from the server, this plugin will stop working — just uninstall it.
